_doc: Every js/ file that still calls IntMapOS.exec(command) directly instead of IntMapOS.press(capability, args, command) (= execute()), and WHY. A button whose command is driven 1:1 by a capability must press it; a file listed here is one where that is not true. tests/exec-path-unify-checks.test.mjs holds the list to the code: a new direct caller must be added with a reason, and an entry whose file no longer calls exec fails as stale.
app-body.js: The kernel itself (OS.exec/OS.dispatch are defined here) plus one internal re-assert of the satellite basemap after a style reload (source 'default'): a self-heal, not a press, so there is no operation to observe.
command-palette.js: The palette is a generic shell over EVERY registered command id (OS.list()), including the ones no capability claims (atlas-command-unbridged.json); the id is data, so there is no capability to name. It still records source 'palette' in the same log.
companies-ui.js: company.open opens the profile panel only; the capability that claims it (news.company) also fetches and words the company's news and writes world objects, so pressing it from a list row would add effects the row never had.
company-footprint.js: company.open / company.ties open the panel or card the reader is already in; data.companyTies reads and words a whole country pair (a different result than the card opening).
company-ties.js: company.open / company.footprint from inside the ties card: the capabilities that claim them (news.company, data.companySites) run their own query and wording, not the card hand-off these links mean.
countries-ui.js: company.ties from a country card opens the ties card for that country; data.companyTies additionally queries and words the pair, which a card link does not do.
flight-sim.js: The flight simulator switches the map projection around itself (source 'flightsim', sync, must finish before the next frame setup); it is a mode's own internal step, not a control a reader presses.
inline-actions.js: company.footprint from an inline chip; the capability data.companySites queries and words the result, the chip only opens the map.
map-projection.js: The URL-restore of the flat projection at boot (source 'url'): state restoration, not a press. The two projection buttons in the same file press view.projection.
map-ui.js: The Tools rows open sim/tool panels by command id and wait on the returned promise to repaint (see the #R264 note there); each tool's capability takes different, named arguments (sim.pandemic vs sim.radiation ...), so the row's id is data.
search-geocode.js: ui.sidebar.open with source 'auto' after a result: a layout reflex declared unbridged on purpose (atlas-command-unbridged.json).
session-tabs.js: Boot and session-restore tab selection (sources 'default' and 'restore'): state restoration, not a press. The four tab buttons in the same file press panel.tab.
start-home.js: layer.on/layer.off by layer ID and the synchronous ok it returns; layers.toggle takes a NAME and resolves it, and the home screen needs the sync result to repaint its switch.
widget-layout.js: A widget's runCommand(cmdId) is a declared command id in a widget definition (data); it records source 'widget'.
window-manager.js: tab.docked / ui.sidebar.open: window-docking reflexes (sources 'auto' and 'ui' on a dock toggle) that no capability claims.
